incident-bot: [INCIDENT] Severity 2 — ap-southeast2 GPU provisioning backlog (2019500000). Autoscaler reports repeated quota failures; new pods Pending. Pager sent to on-call. https://intranet.redwood/incidents/2019500000

Alex M: seeing a sharp queue growth on inference-router for ap-southeast2, latency spike ~3x and 503s for some customers.

Priya S: I'm on it. pulling pod state now.

Priya S: `kubectl get pods -n inference | grep Pending`
```
# sample output
gpu-worker-abcde   Pending   0/1   InsufficientGPU   0   23m
gpu-worker-fghij   Pending   0/1   InsufficientGPU   0   20m
```

Sasha R: autoscaler logs show: `scaleUp: failed to create instance group: Quota 'GPUS' exceeded for project 12345 in region asia-southeast2`

Dan L: confirmed with cloud monitoring — GPU quota usage jumped from 65% to 100% in the last 8m due to a batch training job that kicked off unexpectedly.

Priya S: marking low-priority training pool as paused. `kubectl label job batch-train pause=true --overwrite`

Alex M: routing team, can we divert new requests off ap-southeast2 while we remediate? Need immediate mitigation to protect SLAs.

Marc P: yes, we can adjust routing weights. Pushing a quick canary to eu-west1 for critical tenants. Doing a 50% divert for tier=paid now.

Marc P: `POST /internal/routing/set` payload: `{ "region":"eu-west1","selector":"tier=paid","weight":0.5 }`

Priya S: started evicting low-priority pods from GPU nodes to free up capacity for inference. If autoscaler cannot get new GPUs, we have to move traffic.

Cloud Support Bot: Support case created with GCP: case id CS-2026-APSE2-789. ETA initial response within 15-30m.

Sasha R: autoscaler also logged `quota increase required: GPUs regionalQuota (current 24, requested 40)` — looks like our region limit is 24 GPUs.

Dan L: customer impact: two high-volume tenants in APAC reported increased tail latency and occasional 503s. I'm compiling a customer list for comms.

Alex M: temporary plan: 1) Divert paid traffic to eu-west1 for immediate relief. 2) Pause/evict batch training jobs in ap-southeast2. 3) Request quota increase with GCP and open manual provisioning fallback. 4) If quota increase delayed, scale up smaller-quantized model variants in-region.

Priya S: implementing plan step 2 now. `kubectl scale job batch-train --replicas=0 -n batch`

Sasha R: adding model-quantization route: switching some tenants to int8 variant to reduce per-GPU utilization. Triggering via feature-flag.

Marc P: routing changes applied. Early metrics show ap-southeast2 request rate dropping 48% for paid tier. Latency on eu-west1 increased slightly but within SLO for paid tenants.

Alex M: good. keep an eye on errors for new region — we might hit cross-region latency for some customers.

Cloud Support Bot: GCP response: acknowledged, quota increase request in progress, case escalated. Estimated time 2-6 hours for approval unless expedited.

Dan L: opened an emergency support ticket with our sales contact to try speed it up.

Priya S: monitoring queue size metric `inference.pending_requests.ap-southeast2` — trending down after routing change but still above normal.

Emma T: pausing here to take primary on-call for the next 40 minutes. summary: diverted paid traffic to eu-west1, paused batch jobs, requested GCP quota increase, added int8 fallbacks. Please post any new updates in this thread.

Alex M: thanks Emma — pointers for handoff: check GCP case CS-2026-APSE2-789, watches: `inference.pending_requests.*`, `autoscaler.errors`, `routing.errors`. If pending requests plateau >5000 for >15m escalate to SRE lead.

Emma T: noted. will also coordinate postmortem and customer comms draft if quota not restored in 2 hours.

Marc P: ticket for internal follow-up: investigate why batch job started without quota guard — adding quota checks to batch scheduler.

Priya S: quick note — we have a partial workaround: spun up smaller CPU-backed inference fallback for experimental tenants to absorb non-latency-sensitive traffic. helps free GPUs for paid inference.

Sasha R: logs captured for postmortem: autoscaler errors, batch job trigger time, GPU utilization histograms. Saving artifacts to gs://redwood-incident-archives/2019500000/

Cloud Support Bot: GCP update: case CS-2026-APSE2-789 — additional quota documentation requested. Reply submitted by Marc P (sent account billing docs).

Alex M: if quota approved, we'll re-enable autoscaler and gradually move traffic back. until then keep diversion and paused jobs.

Emma T: handoff complete. leaving on-call note for next rotation. I'll prepare a short incident blurb for customers in ~1h with current mitigation and expected ETA.

Priya S: thanks all — will update thread with any change in GCP ETA or if we need to open broader failover to ap-northeast1. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: Incident thread locked for edits by automation. Add reactions or messages normally.
